 Vs.
Sanjay Kumar ……….Respondent
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. This contempt petition has been filed under Section 
12 of The Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 alleging willful 
and deliberate contempt of Writ Court’s order dated
20.07.2024, WPSS No.2058 of 2023, Bhagwan Chandra 
Pant and others Vs. State of Uttarakhand and another, 
whereby the Writ Court has quashed the order dated 
16.10.2023 and directed the respondents to grant Ist
A.C.P. to the petitioner w.e.f. the date of entitlement after 
completion of ten years regular continuous and 
satisfactory service within a period of not later than eight 
weeks’ from date of judgment and order dated 
20.07.2024.
3. It is contended by learned counsel for the petitioner 
that the State took the matter in Division Bench by filing 
SPA No.54 of 2025, State of Uttarakhand and another Vs. 
Bhagwan Chandra Pant and others, which was dismissed 
as not pressed by the State with a liberty to file review 
application.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the 
order was served upon the respondents on 22.07.2024. 
The copy of the forwarding letter is annexed as annexure 
no.1 to the supplementary affidavit which is taken on  2
record.
5. It is contended by learned counsel for petitioner that 
despite service the order has not been complied with.
6. Issue notice to the respondent-contemnor returnable 
within two weeks.
7. Steps to be taken during course of the day.
8. List this case on 05.10.2026.
9. In the meantime, respondent-contemnor may file 
response or comply with order of the Writ Court.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 16.09.2026
SK
